speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Cholangiocarcinoma (Klatskin tumor). The combination of painless jaundice, pruritus, weight loss, pale stools, and dark urine is classic for extrahepatic biliary obstruction, likely due to a malignancy at the hepatic duct confluence. I would recommend an urgent MRCP and CT abdomen for confirmation.
